title: Digital Thermal Sensors
description: Reads on-die digital thermal sensors for per-core temperature telemetry. DTS sensors sit next to the hottest logic and report with degree-level accuracy. Every thermal decision starts with this data.

demo.title: Demo — Digital Thermal Sensors

title: PID Fan Control
description: Drives fans with a PID controller tracking a temperature target. Proportional response handles spikes, integral kills steady-state error, derivative damps oscillation. Tuned PID keeps noise low and temperatures flat.

demo.title: Demo — PID Fan Control

title: RAPL Power Capping
description: Enforces package power limits with Intel RAPL, throttling frequency to stay under budget. The OS sets a watts-and-window limit; hardware clamps P-states automatically. It guarantees the power envelope no matter the workload.

demo.title: Demo — RAPL Power Capping

title: DVFS Thermal Coupling
description: Couples dynamic voltage and frequency scaling to temperature, not just load. When temperature rises, the governor sheds frequency before the hardware's emergency throttle kicks in. Software throttling is smoother than hardware's cliff.

demo.title: Demo — DVFS Thermal Coupling

title: Workload Migration
description: Migrates threads away from hot cores to cool ones instead of throttling everything. The scheduler watches per-core temperatures and moves work to spread heat. It preserves throughput that blanket throttling would destroy.

demo.title: Demo — Workload Migration

title: Thermal Headroom Scheduling
description: Schedules heavy work on cores with the most thermal headroom. The scheduler scores each core by distance to its thermal limit and places bursty jobs where headroom is largest. It turns temperature into a scheduling dimension.
key_mechanisms: Place bursty jobs on cool cores

demo.title: Demo — Thermal Headroom Scheduling

title: Hotspot Prediction
description: Predicts thermal hotspots from power traces before sensors report them. A thermal RC model converts power history into future temperatures, giving the controller a head start. Prediction beats reaction for fast transients.

demo.title: Demo — Hotspot Prediction

title: Chassis Airflow Modeling
description: Models chassis airflow with CFD to place fans and baffles where they matter. Hot spots often come from recirculation, not total airflow; modeling finds them before hardware is built. It guides both design and fan policy.

demo.title: Demo — Chassis Airflow Modeling

title: Liquid Cooling Control
description: Controls liquid cooling loops: pump speed, coolant temperature, and flow distribution. Liquid removes heat an order of magnitude better than air, but the control loop must avoid condensation and cavitation. It is standard in dense AI clusters.
key_mechanisms: Control pump speed and coolant temp

demo.title: Demo — Liquid Cooling Control

title: Throttling Policy Tiers
description: Defines throttling tiers from gentle frequency trim to emergency shutdown. Each tier has entry and exit thresholds with hysteresis so the system does not oscillate. Policy, not panic, governs the response.

demo.title: Demo — Throttling Policy Tiers

title: Thermal Telemetry Pipelines
description: Streams temperature telemetry from every node into a central time-series store. Fleet-wide thermal data reveals cooling failures and bad placements before they cause throttling. Dashboards make the invisible visible.

demo.title: Demo — Thermal Telemetry Pipelines

title: Emergency Thermal Shutdown
description: Shuts down hardware at the critical temperature to prevent physical damage. It is the last resort after all throttling tiers; the threshold sits below the silicon damage point. Logs capture the event for diagnosis.

demo.title: Demo — Emergency Thermal Shutdown

title: Per-Core Throttling
description: Throttles individual hot cores instead of the whole package. One runaway thread should not punish seven cool cores; per-core P-states isolate the problem. It preserves most throughput during localized heat.
key_mechanisms: Keep cool cores at full speed

demo.title: Demo — Per-Core Throttling

title: GPU Thermal Limits
description: Manages GPU boost clocks against temperature and power limits. GPUs boost opportunistically until they hit thermal or power walls; the driver balances the two. Understanding the limit order explains benchmark variance.

demo.title: Demo — GPU Thermal Limits

title: Datacenter PUE Optimization
description: Optimizes Power Usage Effectiveness by coordinating IT load with cooling. Raising set points, using free cooling, and matching fan speed to load all cut the overhead. PUE near 1.1 is achievable with discipline.

demo.title: Demo — Datacenter PUE Optimization
